say:1:1610706001:1.text: He betrayed us by acing it!
say:1:1610706001:1.source_cn: 埃尔文居然背叛我们的友情，考了满分！

say:2:1610706002:1.text: Uh... shouldn't you be happy your friend did well?
say:2:1610706002:1.source_cn: 呃……难道不是应该为朋友考满分感到高兴吗？

say:3:1610706003:1.text: You don't get it. Last year, all three of us flunked, and we swore we'd improve together.
say:3:1610706003:1.source_cn: 哼，你不知道，去年考试的时候我们三个成绩都不尽人意，当...
say:3:1610706003:1.male: You don't get it. Last year, all three of us flunked, and we swore we'd improve together.
say:3:1610706003:1.female: You don't get it. Last year, all three of us flunked, and we swore we'd improve together.

say:4:1610706004:0.text: But Elvin? He spent all his time queueing at Holt Street or sneaking novels in class. Hadley and I warned him plenty of times, but he didn't care.
say:4:1610706004:0.source_cn: 埃尔文这家伙，每天不是去商业街排队买特调，就是在课堂上...
say:4:1610706004:0.male: But Elvin? He spent all his time queueing at Holt Street or sneaking novels in class. Hadley and I warned him plenty of times, but he didn't care.
say:4:1610706004:0.female: But Elvin? He spent all his time queueing at Holt Street or sneaking novels in class. Hadley and I warned him plenty of times, but he didn't care.

say:5:1610706005:1.text: And yet now he's got a perfect score, and his control of mana is better than ever!
say:5:1610706005:1.source_cn: 谁知道，他这次考试居然考了满分，对魔力的掌控也大有长进！

say:6:1610706006:1.text: He must've been faking the whole time, lulling us into a false sense of security then cramming like crazy at night.
say:6:1610706006:1.source_cn: 他一定是表面上吃喝玩乐，麻痹我们，但私底下刻苦学习，说...
say:6:1610706006:1.male: He must've been faking the whole time, lulling us into a false sense of security then cramming like crazy at night.
say:6:1610706006:1.female: He must've been faking the whole time, lulling us into a false sense of security then cramming like crazy at night.

say:7:1610706007:1.text: I hate people like that the most!
say:7:1610706007:1.source_cn: 该死的，我最讨厌这样的人了！
say:7:1610706007:1.male: I hate people like that the most!
say:7:1610706007:1.female: I hate people like that the most!

say:8:1610706008:1.text: You said he queued for drinks? At the Enchanted Cup, right?
say:8:1610706008:1.source_cn: 你说他去商业街排队买特调？是那家叫魔力绽放的饮品店吗？
say:8:1610706008:1.male: You said he queued for drinks? At the Enchanted Cup, right?
say:8:1610706008:1.female: You said he queued for drinks? At the Enchanted Cup, right?

say:9:1610706009:1.text: Of course! What other shop could it be?
say:9:1610706009:1.source_cn: 当然了，不然还有第二家吗？
say:9:1610706009:1.male: Of course! What other shop could it be?
say:9:1610706009:1.female: Of course! What other shop could it be?

say:10:1610706010:1.text: Sneaky guy... I've gotta call him out on it!
say:10:1610706010:1.source_cn: 这家伙真是太阴险了。我一定要找他问个清楚！
say:10:1610706010:1.male: Sneaky guy... I've gotta call him out on it!
say:10:1610706010:1.female: Sneaky guy... I've gotta call him out on it!
